reference_ratios.name: width_over_length
reference_ratios.source: RVRN CAD: wedglet outer faces 104.1 (z_ref 0.52 mirrored) / 100.4 (disc tip x 8.22 to tyre x 108.59)

reference_ratios.name: blade_stack_over_disc_dia
reference_ratios.source: RVRN CAD: drisk = 3 mm Hardox disc + 8 mm printed spacer (ID 23.3 around the BE1806 can) + 3 mm floating disc = 14 mm on 41.25 mm
reference_ratios.lesson: Spinner energy lives in a laminated ring at the rim, not one thin plate.

reference_ratios.name: rotor_mass_fraction
reference_ratios.source: RVRN CAD + BOM: 2 x 14.7 g Hardox discs, 1.7 g spacer, prop mount, 4 long M2 + nuts and half the 18.5 g BE1806 (its bell turns with the drisk) of 150 g; the 31 g photo figure counted the plates only
reference_ratios.lesson: Budget the rotor first; everything else gets what is left.
